diagnosis_summary: Targeted retrieval top_k expansion and prompt citation/precedence refinement.

root_causes.root_cause: top_k=2 missed secondary documents in cross-document queries.
Agent omitted required inline citations or structured detail.

proposed_changes.rationale: Expand retrieval top_k from 2 to 8 so cross-document evidence chunks are retrieved together.
Require inline [source_file | unit] citations and complete multi-document synthesis.
proposed_changes.summary: Strengthen inline citation and cross-document synthesis instructions.
proposed_changes.prompt_instruction_addition: Include inline [source_file | unit] citations for every factual claim and synthesize all relevant retrieved documents.
